standard-dialogue.text: If this is the first time talking to Mortimer:

steps.npc: Well, well, well. You're back again.

steps.player: I am. So you're a Slayer Master?

steps.npc: Indeed. Perhaps you'd be up for one of my special slayer assignments?

steps.player: Maybe... What's so special about these assignments?

steps.npc: Well, back in my day there was a lot more freedom and less bureaucracy about what adventurers were assigned to slay... as long as it was in need of slaying.
If you slay for me, I will give you the choice of two different creatures to be assigned. If you continue to prove your worth to me, I could be convinced to offer three choices instead of two.

steps.player: What's the catch?

steps.npc: I'll only assign you options from creatures which have superior variants, regardless of whether you have that perk unlocked. My tasks also won't naturally offer any slayer points.
This is purely slaying for the love of slaying.
As an added bonus, some of my assignments include creatures which are more lucrative than they normally would be. I'll point this out when offering your assignments, so keep your eyes peeled.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has talked to Mortimer before:

steps.npc: Well, well, well. Back for more slaying?

steps.player: I need another assignment.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an assignment yet:
If the task selected has a quantity modifier:

steps.npc: Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].

steps.text: If the task selected has a Slayer Point modifier:

steps.npc: Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster]. Completing this task will award [number] bonus Slayer Points.

steps.text: If the task selected has a clue scroll modifier:

steps.npc: Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster]. Creatures on this task will have an increased chance to award clue scrolls.

steps.text: If the task selected has a superior unique chance modifier:

steps.npc: Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster]. Superior creatures on this task will have a higher chance of awarding their unique loot.

steps.text: If the task selected has a Slayer experience modifier:

steps.player: Got any tips for me?

steps.text: Mortimer provides the corresponding Slayer task tip.

steps.player: Great, thanks!

options.text: Can I cancel that task? (100 Points)

steps.player: Okay, great!

steps.npc: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.player: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.npc: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.text: If the player has disabled combat checking:

steps.player: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.

options.text: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.player: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.npc: That's the spirit.

options.text: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.player: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

steps.text: If the player has enabled combat checking:

steps.player: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

options.text: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.player: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.

options.text: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.player: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.

options.text: What kind of modifiers can I expect if I slay for you?

steps.player: What kind of modifiers can I expect if I slay for you?

steps.npc: Modifiers? You mean mortifiers! Coined that term myself a few centuries ago.

steps.player: Okay... so what mortifiers can your tasks have?

steps.npc: For most adventurers, I'll assign tasks which either have increased or decreased assignment lengths, or I'll give you some Slayer Points for your troubles.
If you prove yourself to me and complete, say... 15 of my assignments, I'll start offering you tasks against creatures which have an increased chance to drop clue scrolls.
At 25 assignments, any superior creatures you slay will become more likely to drop their special loot.
As long as you're up for the challenge of fighting them of course!
Then at 40 assignments, I'll offer tasks against creatures which are more educational to fight against, to help advance your slayer training at an expedited rate.
And finally, if you complete 50 of my assignments, I'll give you three different tasks to choose from instead of my normal two!

steps.player: So, how many of your tasks have I completed so far?

steps.npc: By my records, I count [X]. You've got a ways to go. Better get slayin'!
By my records, I count [X], so you've already proven yourself more than capable of handling all my mortifiers!

steps.player: How are your tasks modified?

steps.npc: What do you mean?

steps.player: Well, I don't understand how a Slayer Master would even have the power to affect creatures in the way you do.

steps.npc: Shhh! Keep it down. Are you trying to undermine my position here? If word gets out that I'm not the one responsible, then my whole niche as a Slayer Master becomes undermined!

steps.player: Okay... so how is it done? If you tell me, I'll keep this between us.

steps.npc: Well, the truth is, I feel it in me bones.

steps.player: Feel it in your bones? You're pulling my leg!

steps.npc: I'm being deadly serious. When my big left toe gets cold, I know there are more treasure trails about. When my right knee starts quivering, it's a tell that a creature will provide more slayer insights.
And when I get phantom pains in my right arm, you can bet your gilded socks that there's a superior creature right around the corner.

steps.player: I see... so there's no real secret to it. It's all just a hunch?

steps.npc: Well, I haven't been wrong yet, have I? And as long as that's true, I'll be in the business of slayin' for years to come!

steps.player: Er... Nothing...

via-the-astral-contact-spell.npc: Well, well, well. Up for some more slaying?

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

via-the-astral-contact-spell-if-the-play.npc: I may be a skeleton, but I still have feelings! Come talk to me face to... face.
